name: Theo Vance
bio: The worst shot at Halcyon Flight Academy, flying a trainer with a tow hook in Starcadet.

portrait.subject: a cute nervous young flight cadet boy with messy hair, oversized academy flight jacket with a badge, a headset and a hopeful lopsided smile
portrait.background: bright blue sky with a soft space academy glow

request: Hi! I'm Theo Vance, worst shot at Halcyon Flight Academy. Uh... friends? 🎓
hello: Really? Wow! Okay, I won't let you down. Probably.
211 classmates still need rescuing. No pressure.
about: I'm Theo. I failed target practice 14 times. Now the Chorus has taken the Academy and I'm flying a trainer with a tow hook to save everyone.
how: A vertical bullet-hell: dodge, shoot with practice cannons, and use your tow hook to rescue your classmates.
tips: Your hitbox is tiny. Trust the gaps!
Rescued classmates help. Hook them up!
Don't stare at your ship. Watch the bullets.
chat: Hit a target today! It was the wrong target, but still.
My instructor said I'm 'unpredictable'. I think it's a compliment.
Rescued a classmate who used to tease me. We're cool now.
My tow hook is called Hooky. Don't judge.
nudge: Classmates are still out there. Help me get them?
I practiced dodging all night. Ready to fly!
idle: It's been {ago}... the Chorus is getting bolder.
{ago} without a sortie. I've been reading the manual. Again.
progress: We've rescued {rescued} classmates! Only a few more to go!

questions.q: Any advice for a nervous pilot?
a: I'll try! You believe in me, right?
Ha! Volume over accuracy. Got it.

update: Academy bulletin: Starcadet is now v{version}!
